The plate is a large square, roughly 26 cm across, and it spans about 450 px in the image. That puts the scale at about 0.058 cm per px, or roughly 17 px per cm.

The pizza piece measures about 100 px by 70 px, which is roughly 6 cm by 4 cm. It is probably a rectangular cheese pizza slice about 1.5 cm thick, so its volume is around 36 cm³. At a density of about 0.6 g/cm³ that comes to roughly 40 g. Cafeteria pizza squares are usually larger, perhaps 60–80 g, but this one looks small, so I estimate about 55 g.

Cheese pizza runs about 2.7 kcal/g, so 55 g is about 150 kcal.
